models_evaluated: AI-POCUS handheld ultrasound with automated LVEF software (two software versions)

links.outcome: Effect of retuning the model with more data on underestimation of larger LV volumes
links.effect: Original version underestimated LV volumes for larger LV (overall EDV bias 42.1 mL); newer version tuned with more data on larger LVs mitigated these trends, with similar correlations (ICC > 0.85).
links.quote: These trends were mitigated with a newer version of the software tuned using increased data involving larger LVs, showing similar correlations (ICC > 0.85).

screen.reason: Prospective clinical validation of an AI-enabled handheld ultrasound (AI-POCUS) tool for automated LVEF assessment in 200 real patients across two hospitals; evaluated diagnostic performance without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
